content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Cutting tools, first aid kits and safety products sourced from Asia differ from Olin's chemicals and self-made ammunition."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Specialty ingredients for personal care and pharma differ from Olin's commodity chlor-alkali and ammunition businesses."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and brake components serve construction and transport, not chemicals or ammunition."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Branded household, personal care and vitamin products sold to consumers differ from Olin's industrial chemicals and ammunition."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Mining salt and fertilizer from evaporation operations differs from Olin's chemical manufacturing and ammunition production."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Construction products, HVAC components and industrial valves serve building markets, not chemicals or ammunition."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Specialty polymers, additives and fibers differ from Olin's chlor-alkali, epoxy and ammunition businesses."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Packaged meats and prepared foods share no products, customers or production model with Olin."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Commodity nitrogen chemicals made in own plants for industrial customers resemble Olin's chlor-alkali, though heat pumps differ."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber serve construction and composites, not chemicals or ammunition."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Foil, wrap and trash bags are consumer household disposables sold to grocery retailers, unlike Olin's businesses."}]}
